title: BWF Japan Open 2026: PV Sindhu Wins Women's Singles Title
summary: PV Sindhu becomes 1st Indian badminton player to win Japan Open title.

blocks.content: PV Sindhu becomes 1st Indian badminton player to win Japan Open title.

items: Women's Singles Winner: PV Sindhu defeated Akane Yamaguchi (Japan) in final.
Men's Singles Winner: Christo Popov (France) defeated Koki Watanabe (Japan).
